library(ggpubr)

## Panel A — Representative fluorescence images of GEMs

Panel A contains representative fluorescence microscopy images of genetically encoded
multimeric nanoparticles (GEMs) in WT vs rim15Δ cells. Not R-generated.

Raw images are available on Mendeley Data (doi: [INSERT DOI]).

## Panels B, C, D — GEM diffusion analysis

**BLOCKED — awaiting per-trajectory GEM tracking data from Ying Xie.**

Analysis code for Panels B–D is in `revision3/R05_gem_monomer_gated.Rmd`.
The reanalysis gates on monomeric GEM particles (single-particle intensity window
from proliferating-cell data) to address the reviewer concern that larger aggregated
particles diffuse more slowly by Stokes-Einstein.

Once the data is received, run `revision3/R05_gem_monomer_gated.Rmd` from the
repo root to generate figures in `revision3/output/`, then update this section.

**Panel B:** Mean squared displacement (MSD) vs lag time τ for WT vs rim15Δ
(monomer-gated GEMs).

**Panel C:** Mean GEM intensity vs effective diffusion coefficient (Deff) scatter
plot — illustrates the monomer-gating strategy.

**Panel D:** Deff(100 ms) boxplots for WT vs rim15Δ in proliferating (T=0) and
quiescent (T=16) cells.
